item.title: BATIC 2026 Unites Global Digital Leaders to Accelerate AI-Driven Growth Across Asia-Pacific
item.summary: Telin, as the international business arm of PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (Telkom), is once again hosting the Bali Annual Telkom International Conference (BATIC) 2026 from August 24–28, 2026, at the Bali International Convention Center (BICC), The Westin Resort Nusa Dua, Bali.
